evals.prompt: Create an exploratory data analysis Jupyter Notebook for customer churn dataset with structured sections and visualizations.
evals.expected_output: A valid .ipynb notebook structured with Ingestion, Cleaning, EDA, Visualizations with Seaborn/Matplotlib, and Conclusions.
assertions: Produces a valid Jupyter Notebook (.ipynb) with structured markdown headers
Includes data ingestion and cleaning without mutating raw data inplace
Visualizations configure explicit titles, axis labels, and legends
Uses reproducible environment workflows (uv pip/uv run)

evals.prompt: Build and evaluate a baseline machine learning classification model on feature matrix X and target y with reproducible train/test split and metrics.
evals.expected_output: A reproducible script or notebook establishing a random seed, train/test split, cross-validation, and confusion matrix/classification report.
assertions: Sets explicit random state/seed for reproducible splitting and training
Reports standard evaluation metrics (accuracy, precision, recall, F1-score or ROC-AUC)
Prevents data leakage by fitting transformations solely on the training split
Includes baseline comparison against a dummy or simple classifier
